params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'HeavenBridgeRepo'; if(-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $root '.git'))){ throw 'HeavenBridgeRepo checkout not found' }; git -C $root fetch --quiet origin main; $sha=(git -C $root rev-parse origin/main).Trim(); $tmp=Join-Path $env:TEMP ('mhw-hcp-verify-'+$sha.Substring(0,12)); if(Test-Path $tmp){ git -C $root worktree remove --force $tmp 2>$null; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $tmp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; git -C $root worktree add --detach $tmp $sha | Out-Null; try { Write-Output ('VERIFY_SHA='+$sha); python (Join-Path $tmp 'plugins\heaven-control-plane\verify.py'); if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'heaven-control-plane verify failed' }; git -C $tmp diff --check HEAD^ HEAD; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'git diff --check failed' }; powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File (Join-Path $tmp 'heaven-bridge\manage.ps1') TEST; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'heaven-bridge regression gate failed' }; Write-Output 'HCP_EXACT_MAIN_GATE=PASS' } finally { git -C $root worktree remove --force $tmp 2>$null; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $tmp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
